title: Read generated map scripts
summary: Inspect generated GSC sources, navigate back to authored entities, and find animation helpers.
outcome: A clear view of the scripts the map contributes to a build.

sections.title: Read current generated source

steps.title: Open scripts
steps.text: Choose View → Map Scripts…. Choose a file under Generated files; expand Animation helpers when the map has generated animation sources.

steps.title: Refresh after edits
steps.text: Choose Refresh to regenerate source from the current map without compiling or saving. Use Find or Go to line to inspect the read-only source.

steps.title: Return to map
steps.text: Select a source location and choose Show in map, or select an entity in the map and choose Entity → Show script. This selects and frames linked source entities when they remain visible and selectable.

tips: If Show in map reports a stale map, Refresh first. If an entity is hidden or locked, make it selectable and retry.
Copy source exports text for inspection; this window does not edit generated GSC.
